name: Contrast Enhancement (Levels/Curves) Forgery
description: A death sentence for 'blind photometric manipulators' heavily altering brightness in Photoshop. Whenever a fraudster improperly tweaks Levels, forces Curves, or aggressively adjusts Gamma to blend a spliced object into a background, they permanently fracture the image’s tonal dynamic range. This algorithm guts the pixel architecture to visually expose the shredded histogram caused by crude contrast camouflage.
mechanism: This engine aggressively hunts for the forensic 'Comb Effect'. When intensity is forcefully stretched by AI or manual post-processing, the naturally smooth pixel histogram is violently torn apart—creating abrupt empty zero-pixel voids (Gaps) sandwiched between harsh unnatural spikes (Peaks). The algorithm sweeps the intensity spectrum and arrests any tonal region exhibiting this catastrophic sawtooth mutilation.
parameters: Projection Map: 256-Bin Intensity Histogram, Forensics Tracker: Adaptive Gap/Peak Anomaly Ratio, Isolation Channel: Luma/Y
accuracy: Extremely High (88-95%) - When prosecuting global or regional tonal manipulation, this acts as an unappealable supreme court.
source: Stamm & Liu (2008) - Blind Forensics of Photometric Transformation
useCase: Strip-searches the entire lighting histogram to nail down precisely which spliced components were artificially darkened or brightened to masquerade as part of the original scene.

references.title: Stamm, M.C., & Liu, K.R. (2008). Blind forensics of contrast enhancement in digital images. IEEE ICIP.

strengths:
• Blistering fast processing speeds, striking directly at the raw integer histogram data without needing to perform heavy 3D spatial geometry calculations.
• Efficiently unmasks micro-adjustments in exposure blending that are completely invisible to the naked human eye.
limitations:
• The forensic blade entirely misses its target if a master-class fraudster proactively applies heavy microlocal Dithering (sub-pixel noise injection) to mathematically fill the histogram gaps post-enhancement.
• Easily confused by legitimate authentic HDR (High Dynamic Range) bracketing compositions directly from a high-end camera, triggering massive False Positives.
